direction: Establish a baseline using the allowed static parallel merge template, focusing on conservative route merging to reduce total distance while preserving feasibility under the 25 ms per-instance budget.

operations.mechanism: This is the first round with no archive feedback or prior hypotheses. The only permitted template is cvrp_parallel_merge_static with postprocess_mode none, so the initial experiment should evaluate that template directly as a baseline and gather scalar performance evidence for later refinement.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: A static parallel merge strategy that combines compatible routes without postprocessing will produce feasible CVRP solutions and a measurable baseline for subsequent tuning of merge acceptance criteria.
